name: BestTrack
summary: Shopify order tracking app with a branded tracking page, carrier detection, status email templates and a dropshipping mode.
best_for: Shopify stores that ship fewer than 300 orders a month and want a branded tracking page and carrier detection for free
skip_if: you need SMS shipping alerts, or you want a tracking tool with a long track record before you rely on it
honest_knock: The app launched in April 2026 and has 22 reviews on the Shopify listing. In our test it showed a tracking history almost a year older than the order as Delivered, with no warning. We could not see the customer facing tracking page or any sent email, because our test store is password protected. It supports email only, and mail sends from BestTrack's own address until you verify a domain.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 22 November 2026 on a Shopify development store, with the interface in English. We installed BestTrack on the free plan, fulfilled a test order with UPS's public sample tracking number and looked at the dashboard, billing page, notification settings, dropshipping mode and CSV export. We turned no emails on, upgraded nothing and removed the app afterwards.
findings: Install: the permission screen lists customer data, staff data and store data such as orders. The app then opened straight on its dashboard, with no plan screen, no charge and no card. The dashboard said 300 free tracked orders every month, renewing monthly and not a one time trial.
Tracking: after we fulfilled the test order, it showed up in BestTrack within about 10 seconds with UPS detected. Within about a minute the status was Delivered, with the carrier's full history.
Warning gap: that history ran from a pickup on 12 June 2025 to a delivery on 5 December 2025, for an order placed on 16 November 2026. The app showed it as Delivered and gave no warning.

Emails: every customer status email, such as In transit and Delivery failed, was switched off by default. Mail sends from noreply@support.besttrack.app until you verify your own domain, and free email addresses cannot be verified.
Dropshipping mode: it starts paused and bundles region blocking, custom checkpoints and checkpoint emails. We did not switch it on.
Quota: our one new fulfilment counted as 1 of 300 and the estimated charge was $0.00.
Export: a CSV with 19 columns came down at once, including pickup, fulfilment and delivery dates.
